source.title: Ashenvale Mission XVIII: Rescue Maseara Autumnmoon
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Satyrnaar. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Maseara Autumnmoon there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
source.objective: Rescue Maseara Autumnmoon from the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion at the southeast tent cluster in Satyrnaar and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
